prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:

In the meantime, if you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to me by email and I will be happy to help.

Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to seeing you all next week!

Best regards,
